description: Result of one PtcManager agent action. Every field is required; use an empty string or empty array wherever nothing applies. PtcManager reads only this file, never terminal output.

outcome.description: One value from the allowed_outcomes list in the runtime_context of the task.

why_it_matters.description: Why the maintainer should care, in plain language.

technical_evidence.description: Concrete findings from the repository: files, functions, commands, and their results.

github_changes.description: GitHub records this action actually changed on GitHub (comments posted, labels applied, issues or pull requests created or edited), one entry each. Must be an empty array when github_access is read or none, or when nothing on GitHub was changed. Never list proposed code changes, recommendations, or files to edit here.

evidence.description: Short supporting facts, such as file paths inspected or commands run.

decision_question.description: A question for the maintainer. Only the prepare_issue, report_issue_blocker, review_issue, and resolve_issue_decision actions may fill this, and only with outcome needs-decision; every other action and outcome must use an empty string.

decision_options.description: Answer options for decision_question, two to four entries when it is set; an empty array whenever decision_question is empty.

created_issue_numbers.description: Numbers of GitHub issues this action itself created on GitHub. Only the create_retrospective_issue action with outcome followups-created, or a trusted action reporting completed or no-changes, may list issues; every other action must use an empty array.

suggestions.description: Follow-up issue suggestions. Only the pr_retrospective action with outcome followups-proposed may fill this; every other action and outcome, including private_issue_analysis, must use an empty array. Put analysis findings in technical_evidence instead.
